5735 George Gordon Noel Byron

 
 
 
NUMBER:
5735
 
AUTHOR:
George Gordon Noel Byron, Lord Byron
 (1788–1824)
 
QUOTATION:
Think’st thou existence doth depend on time?
It doth; but actions are our epochs.
 
ATTRIBUTION:
Manfred. Act ii. Sc. 1.
